title: Word Pattern
description: Determine if a string s follows a pattern using bijection between characters and words.
pseudocode:
1. words = s.split(' ')
2. if pattern.length != words.length return false
3. map = {}, set = {}
4. for i from 0 to pattern.length - 1:
5.   char = pattern[i], word = words[i]
6.   if char in map:
7.     if map[char] != word return false
8.   else:
9.     if word in set return false
10.    map[char] = word, set.add(word)
11. return true

steps.note: Split the string s into an array of words.
Index 2: 'b' is already mapped to 'cat'. Check match.
Index 3: 'a' is already mapped to 'dog'. Check match.
All mappings are consistent. Return true.
